# `scene.join`: Join

Merges several mesh objects into one, keeping their world shapes.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(total mesh size + targets x log n + children x depth)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: ctrl j, combine, merge objects, attach

The other objects' meshes move into the receiving object's space and are appended as separate parts; the other objects are removed and their children move to the receiver. Groups with the same name merge.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `into` | `string \| null` | `null` | The object that receives the others; the first target when omitted. |
| `targets` | `string[]` | required | Mesh objects to join (at least two). |

## Examples

```json
{"targets":["crate","post"]}
```

Result: `joined 2 objects into crate (o:1): 38 faces`
